sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
அக்ஷய விநாயகனே ஆதரித்தாள்பவனே
பிக்ஷா பாத்திர மூலவனே பீதாம்பரதாரனே
sections.translit:
akshaya vinAyaganE AdharitthALbavanE
bhikshA pAtthira mUlavanE pIthAmbaradhAranE
sections.en: Everlasting Vinayaka, you are the supporter and leader of your devotees. You are the originator of the limitless vessel that feeds the hungry, you who is adorned in exquisite silk.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
இடம் அறிந்து பொருளறிந்து ஈவதிலே
திடம் ஆனவன் நீயெனல் மெய்யன்றோ
sections.translit:
idam aRindhu poruLaRindhu IvadhilE
dhidam Anavan nIyenal meyyandRo
sections.en: Is it not a fact that you are an expert in judging what to give to whom, and how much?

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
மாதவன் வாஹனன்பால் நீதந்த பாத்திரம்
ஆதவன் ஒளிபோல் திருக்கையால் உருமாறி
சகதி சேர் வாழ்வினில் ஆறாத்துயரொடு கானில்
அகதி போல் குமைந்த பாஞ்சாலிக்கு உதவியதே
sections.translit:
mAdhavan vAhananpAl nIthandha pAtthiram
Adhavan oLipOl thirukkaiyAl urumARi
sagadhi sEr vAzhvinil ARAtthuyarodu kAnil
agadhi pOl kumaindha pAnjAlikku udhaviyadhE
sections.en: The perpetual vessel that you handed down to Garuda, vehicle of Lord Vishnu, changed so many hands. It shone with the bright rays of sun because of your touch and ended up in the hands of Draupathi. The poor damsel who was spending time in the forest, like a despairing refugee in this muddy world, received the gift of the vessel and it helped her immensely. (Is this not amazing? Is this also preordained by you?)

notes: This song is based on the sthalapuranam of Arasar Koil Sundara Mahalakshmi temple, located near Kancheepuram. Legend states that devi offered the Akshaya Paatra vessel via Selva Ganapathi originally to Vishnu’s Vahana Garuda. By Sri Vinayaka’s divine order Garuda carried the vessel and dropped it off with Surya, who in turn offered it to Yudhishtra to help Panchali during her stay in the forest (based on legends associated with the temple published in Dinamalar supplement which the author could not retrieve). However, the blogspot below describes the transfer of Akshaya Paatra vessel (section on akshaya tritiya para 5 and 15) from Akshaya Vinayaka to Garuda and transfer to Surya and Mahabharata's account of the transfer of the vessel from Surya to Yudhishtra. This is also confirmed in Surya puranam.* Transfer of Akshaya Paatra - section: Akshaya Tritiya – A day for charity and sharing of all wealth. Garuda receives Akshaya Paatra - section: "Vaidya Shakti" Garuda Draupadi receives Akshaya Paatra - section: Legend ஶ்ரீ மஹாபாரத ஸாரம், உரை ஆசிரியர் “அண்ணா”, ஶ்ரீராமகிருஷ்ண மடம், மயிலாப்பூர், சென்னை 600004, பக்கம் 411, 421-423. Greatness of Arasar koil *சூரிய புராணம் எழுதியவர்: கார்த்திகேயன் (எஸ்.ராமநாதன்), பதிப்பகத்தார் : கிரி டிரேடிங் ஏஜென்ஸி பிரைவேட் லிமிடெட், சென்னை, 2nd Reprint July 2003, புராணங்களில் காணப்படும் கதைகள் 7. ஆதித்தன் தந்த அக்ஷய பாத்திரம், பக்கம் 196-199.
